title: Romantic Safari Experiences for Two
excerpt: Balloon flights, bush dinners and stargazing: romantic experiences for couples on safari in Tanzania.
body:
- **[Balloon flight](/blog/serengeti-balloon-safari/)** at sunrise over the Serengeti.
- **[Bush dinner](/blog/bush-dinner-serengeti/)** by lantern light.
- **Sundowners** on a kopje.
- **Star beds:** sleeping under the open sky on a platform, offered by some camps.
- **A private game drive** with breakfast in the bush.
- **Outdoor bath or shower** with a view.
- **A [sunset dhow cruise](/blog/sunset-dhow-cruise/)** on Zanzibar.

## Tell us

Let us know it is a special trip, and we will include the right touches.

[Plan your romantic trip](/travel-proposal/).
